models.title: The Overlook
models.subtitle: A swim. A workout. A place to gather.
models.alt: Miniature of the Overlook’s white gables, stone piers, balcony, pavilions and pool.
models.basis: Photo-informed miniature. Interior rooms and entrances are not mapped.

models.title: Pickleball at Burns
models.subtitle: Eight courts. Bring your game.
models.alt: Architectural miniature of eight blue pickleball courts with green surrounds, fencing and shaded seating.
models.basis: Based on CAB’s court concept. Finishes and planting are illustrative.

models.title: Play at Prospect
models.subtitle: Room for everyone to join in.
models.alt: Photo-informed miniature of Prospect’s inclusive playground with lime shade sails, green railings, ramps and accessible glider.
models.basis: Photo-informed playground study, not a model of the whole park.

overlook.summary: The neighborhood’s pool, fitness and gathering place at 7853 Piney River Avenue.
highlights: Explore the pool, fitness room, Great Hall and two pavilions below.
Pool availability is seasonal. Check CAB’s pool page before heading over.
Facility access and room rentals have their own rules; follow the CAB links for your visit.

overlook-pool.summary: The outdoor pool at the Overlook. Check the current season, schedule and access rules before packing your swim bag.
highlights: CAB publishes pool hours, closures, entry rules and guest information.
The model shows the facility, not whether the pool is open today.

burns.summary: Start with the eight outdoor pickleball courts. The wider regional park is being developed in phases.
highlights: Use CAB’s court page for CourtReserve bookings and drop-in play.
Bring paddles and balls, and wear court shoes.
The larger park’s future amenities are listed separately below.

burns-courts.summary: Eight outdoor pickleball courts at Middle Fork Street and Sterling Ranch Avenue, with reservations and drop-in play.
highlights: Bring your own paddles and balls.
Check CAB’s current schedule and CourtReserve link before you go.

actions.label: Book a court or check open play
